_comment: DEV set: EXAMPLE labels tied to ONE specific video library (the maintainer's) — the video names below will NOT exist in your library, so REPLACE these cases with your own. The search heuristics were tuned against these queries, so passing them says little about generalization; see search_labels_test.json for the held-out set. Format: query -> expected video name(s). expect_top: that name must be the #1 result. expect_in: all listed names must appear in results. Optional sources: both|video|audio (default both). The harness (eval_search.py) is generic and works with any labels file via --labels.
